description.en: 8B delay-pattern MOSS-TTS: zero-shot voice cloning from a short reference, 24 kHz, with an explicit duration budget.
description.zh: 8B 延迟模式 MOSS-TTS：从短参考零样本克隆音色，24 kHz，带显式时长预算。

instruct.en: Voice description. Followed only loosely on this checkpoint; a reference recording is far more reliable.
instruct.zh: 音色描述。此检查点对其遵循较松；提供参考录音要可靠得多。

language.en: Full language name; the model does not understand codes like 'en'.
language.zh: 完整语言名称；该模型不识别 'en' 这类代码。

seed.en: Reproduces a take exactly; default 0. Parsed as signed 32-bit integer then converted to uint32; negative values wrap.
seed.zh: 准确再现镜头；默认 0。解析为有符号 32 位整数，然后转换为 uint32；负值换行。

temperature.en: Audio sampling temperature; default 1.5. Must be finite and positive when sampling.
temperature.zh: 音频采样温度；默认 1.5。采样时必须是有限且正的。

top_p.zh: 音频核心采样截止；默认 0.6。

repetition_penalty.en: Audio repetition penalty; default 1.1. Must be finite and positive when history is nonempty.
repetition_penalty.zh: 音频重复惩罚；默认 1.1。当历史非空时，必须是有限且正的。

min_frames.en: Minimum generated audio frames per text chunk; nonpositive values derive a text-length-based floor. Separate from duration_frames conditioning.
min_frames.zh: 每个文本分块生成音频帧的下限；非正值按文本长度推导下限。与 duration_frames 条件分开。

max_frames.en: Generated audio-frame ceiling per text chunk; nonpositive values derive a text-length-based ceiling. Runtime raises it to at least the effective min_frames plus the number of codebooks.
max_frames.zh: 每个文本分块生成音频帧上限；非正值按文本长度推导上限。运行时会提升到至少有效 min_frames 加 codebook 数。

duration_frames.en: Duration budget in codec frames at 12.5 a second, the model's own '- Tokens:' field. Nonpositive values disable duration conditioning.
duration_frames.zh: 以 12.5 帧/秒计的 codec 时长预算，即模型自身的 '- Tokens:' 字段；非正值关闭时长条件。

text_temperature.en: Text-token sampling temperature. Must be finite and positive when sampling.
text_temperature.zh: 文本 token 采样温度；采样时必须为有限正数。

text_chunk_size.en: Maximum Unicode codepoints per long-form text chunk; default 200.
text_chunk_size.zh: 每个长文本分块的最大 Unicode 码点数；默认 200。

text_chunk_mode.en: Text chunking policy; word_budget also accepts default.
text_chunk_mode.zh: 文本分块策略；word_budget 也接受 default。
